title: Restriction of modules to an open subscheme is exact and preserves injectives; direct image along the open immersion preserves injectives
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U\subseteq X$ an open subscheme with inclusion $j:U\to X$, and for an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] let $\mathcal G|_U$ be the restricted $\mathcal O_U$-module, $(\mathcal G|_U)(W)=\mathcal G(W)$ for $W\subseteq U$ open [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]; let $j_*:\Mod(\mathcal O_U)\to\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ be the direct image, $(j_*\mathcal H)(W)=\mathcal H(W\cap U)$. Then: (1) the functor $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)\to\Mod(\mathcal O_U)$, $\mathcal G\mapsto\mathcal G|_U$, is exact; (2) if $\mathcal I$ is an injective $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sp-injective-resolutions], then $\mathcal I|_U$ is an injective $\mathcal O_U$-module; (3) if $\mathcal J$ is an injective $\mathcal O_U$-module, then $j_*\mathcal J$ is an injective $\mathcal O_X$-module. Consequently, if $\mathcal F\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ is an injective resolution of an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$, then $\mathcal F|_U\to\mathcal I^\bullet|_U$ is an injective resolution of $\mathcal F|_U$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_U)$.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma 01E1 (lemma-cohomology-of-open, line 495) part (1) and its proof (restriction is right adjoint to the exact extension by zero j_!, Sheaves Lemma 00A7 (sheaves-lemma-j-shriek-modules), so Homology Lemma 015Z (homology-lemma-adjoint-preserve-injectives) applies; 'F|_U -> I^bullet|_U is an injective resolution'); for (3) Cohomology Lemma 02N5 (lemma-pushforward-injective-flat, line 1820: f_* of an injective is injective for flat f, an open immersion being flat), equivalently 015Z for the adjunction (-)|_U -| j_* with (-)|_U exact
